name: apple-icloud
description: Read-only access to your iCloud Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and Mail from your agent, using an Apple app-specific password. Nothing is sent, deleted or modified.

APPLE_ID.title: Apple ID email
APPLE_ID.description: The email address of your Apple ID, used to sign in to iCloud Calendar, Reminders and Contacts.

APPLE_APP_PASSWORD.title: App-specific password
APPLE_APP_PASSWORD.description: An app-specific password created at https://account.apple.com (Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords). Never use your normal Apple ID password. You can revoke it at any time.

APPLE_MAIL_USER.title: iCloud Mail login (optional)
APPLE_MAIL_USER.description: Optional. Only for Mail: your @icloud.com address, if your Apple ID is a third-party email (for example Gmail). Leave blank to use the Apple ID.
